reviewSamples.author: Barbara Cornell
reviewSamples.text: I used their services for trash removal, mattresses, chairs, metal, etc. They were prompt on time. I didn't have to wait and they were very affordable. Their service was nice. The workers are excellent. I recommend 1000%.

reviewSamples.author: Lucianne Hosten
reviewSamples.text: Marcus was the greatest. Very professional, extremely quick. Working by himself it was AWESOME, AMAZING. Give him a raise. HE DESERVES IT 100%.

reviewSamples.author: Raya A
reviewSamples.text: Thank you so much Boris and the team! You helped me a lot with the junk removal. Marvelous, professional service, same day appointment, quick, reliable, friendly people!

reviewSamples.author: Lauren Fulk
reviewSamples.text: I needed a sofa removed and they were here within 20 minutes, on New Year's Eve! Had to spend 10 minutes tearing it into pieces to get it through the door and they were gone. Very polite, fast, and reasonable.
